review.imagery: Fourteen native project renders were visually reviewed. The full tower view supplies the card and hero. Further views cover facade, aerial setting, three living-room configurations, lobby, pools, outdoor cinema, fitness and recreation. The open sofa bed is labeled as a proposed furniture arrangement, without inventing a bedroom interior. Duplicate current-gallery scenes, colored backgrounds and generic people photographs are excluded. Some official amenity scenes also appear in Greenfield 2 material. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Eight home drawings and three building sheets retain complete source pages. Numerical unit areas are absent. The developer’s shared building pack is linked separately. Convertible labels require confirmation of the approved configuration and contractual area. Private pools are not confirmed by these home drawings. All eight complete brochure pages 32–39 and the shared building-pack pages 2–4 were individually reviewed. Position keys distinguish the original project. No private pools are drawn on these home layouts, despite the primary FAQ’s universal claim. Broad factbook areas and the primary minimum are not assigned to individual drawings. The building pack covers ground retail/access, the first-floor homes/amenities and floors 2–14. It does not establish additional retail unit layouts or their areas.
review.location: Complete original brochure page 7 was visually reviewed. Its six printed estimates are retained, distinct from the primary page’s ranges. The official q coordinate 25.14586733523734, 55.4027283937112 is saved with source hash and six-place conversion. The pin retains project-vicinity scope. The dotted Blue Line is marked future infrastructure. No road distance or visitor entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh official HTML, original developer brochure, shared building pack and factbook retain retrieval receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins, whole-sheet notices and physical-page PDF links are retained. Protected identity, completed commercial/text research, phase separation and existing conflicts are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific areas, contractual convertible-layout approval, confirmed private pools, a verified entrance coordinate, current metro access and dated construction photography were not established. Published travel-source differences remain qualified.
